summary:
I've been building a character-creation extension for SillyTavern that runs characters through a structured interview instead of one-shot generating them from a prompt. I did a competitive survey of the space first — the one real incumbent (157 stars) does prompt-in, fields-out with a chat-based refine loop, but nobody does interview-first elicitation or forges personas alongside characters. That's the gap I'm building into.

The interesting engineering problem turned out to be caching, not generation. Everything runs through one shared GPU, so any RP session that busts the model's prefix cache means a 30-60 second full re-prefill on every single turn instead of a couple of seconds. I chased that down through several layers — SillyTavern quietly rewrites parts of the prompt as a chat grows (dropping example dialogue, swapping which character card sits on top in group chats), and each of those was independently resetting the cache. Getting solo chats to stay cache-stable took making the character's lore "always-on" instead of conditionally triggered, which sounds backwards until you realize a few hundred constant tokens is way cheaper than a full re-prefill.

I also hit a case where the character-forging code silently overwrote a saved character with an invented one — it was supposed to fill in unspecified details from a live chat transcript, but on a device with no chat history it filled in from nothing and clobbered a character I'd already built out over several sessions. I recovered it from a settings backup and then fixed the root cause: no transcript now means build from what's already saved, not invent from scratch.

Most of the rest is plumbing work to keep multiple model backends (chat, image generation, summarization) sharing one GPU without stepping on each other, so a request for one doesn't stall or crash a request for another.

highlights.oneLiner: Building an interview-first character-creation extension for SillyTavern
Chasing prefix-cache stability so shared-GPU RP sessions avoid full re-prefills
